title: Extract a shared test helper for locating lib/ source files instead of 13 ad hoc reimplementations

evidence.quote: 'lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/settings_screen.dart', (2nd independent read of the same file, AC4)
'lib/features/tracks/setup/presentation/screens/add_track_flow.dart', (byte-identical block to line 169, 38 lines later, same file)

why: Five files in this batch each hand-roll their own version of 'locate a lib/ source file whether cwd is the app root or the repo root': a plain candidates.firstWhere(orElse: ...) (story_16 x2, story_20 x5, story_6 x1), a _projectRoot()+readFeatureFile() pair (story_31), and a _src() helper that is itself bypassed twice for a byte-identical inline duplicate 38 lines apart in the same file (story_7, lines 169 and 207). test/helpers/ has no such helper (only drift_memory.dart, firestore_fake.dart, golden_runner.dart, migration_test_helper.dart, overflow_harness.dart, test_database.dart exist). story_20 independently re-reads settings_screen.dart from scratch in two separate setUpAll blocks (AC3 and AC4) instead of sharing one read. Any future change to how these tests resolve project-relative paths means fixing the same ~10-line block by hand in 13 places, and failure behavior already differs silently between copies (some throw StateError immediately, some fall back to an empty string and let a later contains() assertion fail with a confusing message).
recommendation: Add a single `String readLibSource(String relativePath)` / `bool libFileExists(String relativePath)` to test/helpers/ with one consistent failure behavior and migrate all 13 call sites onto it.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/ exposes one shared source-file-lookup helper used by the story_16/20/31/6/7 files
grep -c 'final candidates = \[' across those 5 files trends to 0 outside the shared helper
